Go Turf Video Projects.

Go Turf is the Sunshine Coast’s premier turf farm. It is a family run business located on the Pumicestone Passage with spectacular views of the Glasshouse Mountains. With a range of turf on offer, delivery and installation is all taken care of.

Carrying out several shoot days over the past 4 years, the footage and images shot by Pepper Productions have showcased the Go Turf family, farm, machinery, fertilisers and not forgetting their stunning range of turf. It is always a pleasure to spend a day on the Go Turf Farm.
